reports.title: Sphinx N and E faces
reports.comment: quick: Some shooting cracks observed in new storm snow soft slab on steeper slopes.  Turned back to ski less commuting terrain

reports.title: Tree Triangle
reports.comment: quick: Epic powder! Lots of loading over the last few days made for good skiing and some results on the new snow in a column test. / weather: Bit windy and snowing all day. Noticed a fair amount of cornices falling on the ridge near Giza Couloir. / snowpack: Failure at 4 hits on column test. Failed on storm snow. Solid mid pack with a few layers of concern.

reports.title: Monarch Ramparts
reports.comment: quick: Our group of 7 toured up to Healy Pass and then up the Ramparts for a few turns. It was snowing hard for most of our time in the alpine, as well as very windy. We skied open trees and alpine slopes to 35 degrees. No snow stability issues were noted.

reports.title: Pharaoh Peak
reports.comment: incident: Avalanche occurred 2020.02.23. SW aspect of Pharaoh Peak, Banff NP. Avalanche ran approx. 700m, Crown was approx. 150m wide, Depth was variable from 30-100 cm, bed-surface was mostly ground. Party of 4 was boot-packing to gain Pharaoh Peak ridge, crown broke near ridge top. reports.title: Egypt Lake Shelter
reports.comment: quick: Our party of 5 departed for Egypt Lake Shelter on March 6th from the Sunshine Village parking lot. It took us approximately 7 hours to get to our destination. After a long day of constant snow fall and low visibility we decided to stay in for the night instead of trying to find some slopes. reports.title: Vermilion Crossing
reports.comment:
quick: Had a fun day in the Vermilion Crossing area. The snow was soft powder on top of a harder layer about 10cms down. There was some isolated wind affect too, those north winds did not do us any favours. Starting temp was -27C, with the ending temp around -3C!! (Should be noted the snow did not seem to be reacting to this temp change yet)
